title: ReactAll integration with ReactWise
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
If you run ReactALL from Technobis, your data now flows straight into ReactWise.


ReactALL is a benchtop platform with independently controlled reactors and fully automated sampling - the export files import directly into ReactWise, no reformatting needed.


Combined with analytical results, that data feeds Bayesian optimization and drives recommendations for the next experimental run.


For deeper understanding of the intrinsic kinetics, Kinetics360 automatically identifies reaction mechanisms, orders, and rate parameters.


If your team uses ReactALL and wants to streamline process optimization, we'd be happy to show you how it works.


Find out more about Technobis and ReactAll[here.](https://www.crystallizationsystems.com/)
